rationale: The release workflow repeatedly fetches and compiles Rust cargo dependencies across a three-OS matrix, and the repository contains a Cargo.lock that provides a stable cache key. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) is supported by measured evidence of modest CI savings, its preconditions are met (repeated dependency fetching; lockfile- and runner-scoped cache input), and no equivalent cache exists in the workflow. Adding a cache for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git keyed on Cargo.lock and runner.os reuses downloaded crate sources across runs without caching unchecked build outputs, preserving all build/test steps and required checks. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or privileged actions are added, and no new network access is introduced beyond the existing cargo operations.
